comments.body: 🤖 `om-auto-review-pr` started by @haxiorz at 2026-11-11T21:06:30Z. Other auto-skills will skip this PR until the lock is released.

🤖 `om-auto-review-pr` — 🏷️ label rationale

- 🔍 `review` — the code pass found no actionable defect and the PR stays queued for the gate run it still needs.
- 🐛 `bug` — the change fixes failed workflow steps being skipped when a parallel branch resumes.
- ⏭️ `skip-qa` — the diff touches only `workflows/lib/parallel-handler.ts` and its unit test; no UI file, schema, or API surface changes, and the changed behavior ships with tests.
- 🔹 `priority-medium` — a wrong branch outcome in a supported workflow is an ordinary correctness bug, not a release blocker.
- 🟡 `risk-medium` — one workflow engine helper with unit coverage, no schema or contract change.
